# google_cloudbuild_git_lab_config

GitLabConfig represents the configuration for a GitLab integration.


To get more information about GitLabConfig, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/build/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.gitLabConfigs)
* How-to Guides
    * [Connect to a GitLab host](https://cloud.google.com/build/docs/automating-builds/gitlab/connect-host-gitlab)

## Example Usage - Cloudbuild Gitlab Config


```hcl
resource "google_cloudbuild_git_lab_config" "gitlab-config" {
    config_id = "gitlab-config"
    location = "us-central1"
    username = "test-user"
    secrets {
        webhook_secret_version = "projects/myProject/secrets/mysecret/versions/1"
        api_key_version = "projects/myProject/secrets/mysecret/versions/1"
        api_access_token_version = "projects/myProject/secrets/mysecret/versions/1"
        read_access_token_version = "projects/myProject/secrets/mysecret/versions/1"
    }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `secrets` -
  (Required)
  Secret Manager secrets needed by the config.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_secrets).

* `config_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID to use for the GitLabConfig, which will become the final component of the GitLabConfig's resource name.

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of this GitLab config.


* `username` -
  (Optional)
  Username of the GitLab.com or GitLab Enterprise account Cloud Build will use.

* `connected_repositories` -
  (Optional)
  Connected GitLab.com or GitLabEnterprise repositories for this config.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_connected_repositories).

* `enterprise_config` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. GitLabEnterprise config.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_enterprise_config).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



<a name="nested_secrets"></a>The `secrets` block supports:

* `webhook_secret_version` -
  (Required)
  Immutable. The resource name for the webhook secret's secret version. Once this field has been set, it cannot be changed.

* `api_key_version` -
  (Required)
  Immutable. API Key that will be attached to webhook requests from GitLab to Cloud Build.

* `api_access_token_version` -
  (Required)
  The resource name for the api access token's secret version.

* `read_access_token_version` -
  (Required)
  The resource name for the read access token's secret version.

<a name="nested_connected_repositories"></a>The `connected_repositories` block supports:

* `id` -
  (Required)
  Identifier for the repository. example: "namespace/project-slug", namespace is usually the username or group ID

* `webhook_id` -
  (Output)
  Output only. The ID of the webhook that was created for receiving events from this repo. We only create and manage a single webhook for each repo.

<a name="nested_enterprise_config"></a>The `enterprise_config` block supports:

* `host_uri` -
  (Optional)
  Immutable. The URI of the GitlabEnterprise host.

* `service_directory_config` -
  (Optional)
  The Service Directory configuration to be used when reaching out to the GitLab Enterprise instance.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_enterprise_config_service_directory_config).

* `ssl_ca` -
  (Optional)
  The SSL certificate to use in requests to GitLab Enterprise instances.


<a name="nested_enterprise_config_service_directory_config"></a>The `service_directory_config` block supports:

* `service` -
  (Optional)
  The Service Directory service name. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/namespaces/{namespace}/services/{service}.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/gitLabConfigs/{{config_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name for the config.

* `create_time` -
  Output only. Time when the config was created.

* `webhook_key` -
  Output only. UUID included in webhook requests. The UUID is used to look up the corresponding config.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


GitLabConfig can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/gitLabConfigs/{{config_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{config_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{config_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/identities) to import GitLabConfig using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    config_id = "<-required value->"
    location = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_cloudbuild_git_lab_config.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import GitLabConfig using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/gitLabConfigs/{{config_id}}"
  to = google_cloudbuild_git_lab_config.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), GitLabConfig can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_cloudbuild_git_lab_config.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/gitLabConfigs/{{config_id}}
$ terraform import google_cloudbuild_git_lab_config.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{config_id}}
$ terraform import google_cloudbuild_git_lab_config.default {{location}}/{{config_id}}
```
